0a13cdc6b05516ed.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide real-time system monitoring for Razorpay’s top merchants and enterprise-wide transactions, with immediate stakeholder alerts during performance issues
  • Transform merchant key metrics into actionable business intelligence through comprehensive data analysis
  • Execute timely communication to stakeholders during system incidents or data anomalies
  • Build and maintain interactive dashboards for internal performance tracking and metric visualization
  • Identify meaningful patterns, trends, and inferences through data analytics
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve issues and implement improvements
Required Qualifications
  • Proven ability to manage and interpret large-scale datasets
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence tools and data manipulation techniques (Tableau, looker etc)
  • Knowledge of SQL for data extraction and analysis
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work 24/7 in shifts
Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
 
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

Greetings from TCS!

Hiring: Generative AI Engineer / Developer

Role: Engineer / Developer
Primary Skill: Generative AI
Experience: 8–10 years
Location: Bangalore
Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or above

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer/Developer to design, develop, and productionize AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern Generative AI frameworks.
The ideal candidate should have strong software engineering foundations along with hands-on experience building enterprise-grade GenAI, RAG, prompt engineering, and LLM-based solutions.

Mandatory Skills
• Strong programming experience in Python.
• Hands-on experience building Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
• Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Transformer-based architectures.
• Hands-on experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
• Experience with prompt engineering and prompt optimization techniques.
• Experience with GenAI frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
• Experience working with vector databases/vector search, such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search, or equivalent.
• Knowledge of embeddings, semantic search, chunking, retrieval, and reranking techniques.
• Experience integrating LLMs through APIs and REST services.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, model evaluation, and data preprocessing.
• Experience developing scalable, production-grade applications using sound software engineering practices.
• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, testing, debugging, and deployment practices.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
• Build GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and vector search.
• Develop and optimize prompts for different business use cases.
• Design document ingestion, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and reranking pipelines.
• Integrate LLM capabilities into existing applications and APIs.
• Evaluate LLM responses for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, and hallucination risk.
• Implement guardrails and appropriate security controls for enterprise GenAI applications.
• Optimize GenAI applications for latency, scalability, reliability, and cost.
• Develop reusable AI components, APIs, and services.
• Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, architects, and application teams to productionize GenAI solutions.
• Follow coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD practices.

Good to Have
• Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI platforms.
• Knowledge of fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and model adaptation techniques.
• Exposure to MLOps/LLMOps practices.
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
• Understanding of responsible AI, LLM security, monitoring, and governance.
• Experience with agentic AI or multi-agent workflows.

0a07436234a8b52e.description: Location: India, Remote Type: Full-time Team: AI / Engineering About hpy hpy is building AI that understands people, not just language. Most of todays AI systems are remarkably good at understanding what someone said. They are considerably less capable of understanding how someone is feeling, why their emotional state is changing, and what kind of interaction might actually improve their wellbeing. We think that distinction matters. Human wellbeing is influenced by patterns that unfold over time: emotion, behavior, relationships, environment, physiology, meaning and context. Todays models see fragments of this picture. We want to help them understand more of it. We started in behavioral health, building technology that understands conversations, identifies emotional signals, synthesizes longitudinal context and helps professionals better understand the people they serve. But behavioral health is our starting point, not the boundary of what were building. We are exploring the intersection of AI, emotion and human wellbeing and how hpys underlying intelligence can extend into entirely new products and verticals. The question were interested in is: What becomes possible when AI can understand not only what a person is doing, but how they are doing Were looking for an exceptional India-based engineer to help us answer that question. The role This is a hybrid engineering and applied research role. You will work closely with hpys founder and our partners to extend hpys core intelligence into new products and verticals. You should be comfortable moving across the entire stack: building an interface, designing the backend, constructing the AI pipeline behind it, evaluating a new model and putting the resulting product in front of a partner. Some projects will begin with a customer problem. Others may begin with a new research paper, model or capability that makes something possible that wasnt possible six months ago. We expect you to be paying attention to both. What youll work on You will: Extend hpys emotion and context intelligence into new wellbeing verticals.Build experiments around how models understand emotion, behavior and longitudinal human context.Prototype and ship full-stack AI products from idea through production.Evaluate frontier foundation models, multimodal models and emerging AI infrastructure.Build agentic systems that reason across conversations, structured information and external tools.Develop evaluation frameworks for measuring emotional and contextual understanding.Explore fine-tuning, representation learning, embeddings and domain-specific model adaptation.Work with large conversational and emotional datasets.Work directly with partners to deeply understand workflows and translate ambiguous problems into products.Move rapidly from research prototype user feedback production. What were looking for Were looking for an unusually strong generalist engineer with deep curiosity about AI. You should be able to move comfortably between research and engineering. You dont need someone else to translate a paper into an experiment or an experiment into a product. We value: Exceptional technical foundations. Strong computer science fundamentals and the ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, infrastructure and ML systems. Deep AI fluency. You actively follow frontier models, papers and tooling. When something important ships, you want to understand how it works, test it and determine whether it changes what we can build. Strong product instincts. You care about the human problem rather than simply completing a specification. Excellent communication. You can speak directly with partners, ask good questions, understand complex workflows and turn those conversations into technical decisions. High agency. You are comfortable being given an outcome rather than a ticket. Intellectual curiosity. You are interested not only in making models work, but understanding why they work and where they fail. We have a strong preference for candidates from top-tier engineering and research universities in India or globally, or candidates who can demonstrate an equivalent level of technical ability through exceptional research, open-source work or products they have built. Major plus Experience developing or training models from scratch. We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone deeper than simply calling foundation-model APIs. Knowledge, Skills, and experience required Extensive experience leading AWS and cloud data platform transformations Proven track record of delivering large-scale data and analytical solutions in a cloud environment Hands-on experience in end-to-end data pipeline implementation using AWS services, including data preparation, extraction, transformation & loading, normalization, aggregation, warehousing, data lakes, and data governance Expertise in developing data warehouses and in-depth understanding of modern data architecture such as Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Mesh Strong knowledge of data architecture and data modelling practices, with the ability to cost-effectively manage data pipelines Data Modelling,Python, SQL, NoSQL DBs (Mongo), Snowflake, AWS Cloud, APIs, Tableau, PowerBI, DQ Framework, DWH, Real time reporting .
